text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah....
I gave it my all, but... this is my limit...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Ayabe-san.
Yet, even more than that...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... Somehow managed to pull off a win...
I held it together despite being in bad shape...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
“Still... what was that?
I knew Top Road-san was strong.
But still...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Admire Vega, who seized victory.
Narita Top Road, who put up a brilliant run.
What stole both of their attention was..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, this is as far as you go? How pathetic.
However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'd say it made for quite an exciting revue.
Plus—I gained the conviction that we can compete on equal footing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: T.M.... Opera O-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(What incredible spirit...
Even though she was still maiden at the start of this year,
she's improved so quickly to make it all the way here...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Just how hard has she been working?
Her momentum today is...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm so sorry,
I'm so frustrated. I just couldn't reach them at all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san was really strong after all...
choice_data_list: No, it couldn't be helped. You did great
No, it couldn't be helped. You did great.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her lackluster late charge was due to the track condition.
That's certainly true, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's another reason for the loss. There was an Umamusume exerting terrifying pressure.
And that was—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Top Road-san, Ayabe-san.
That was quite a splendid opening act, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I would love for our next race to go just like this.
A fiery waltz!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closer, her cheeks were pale from exhaustion,
and her body was still frail...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting the year with a winning streak before even properly preparing.
And then pushing forward through a grueling schedule to enter the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, her body would never hold up. And yet,
this sheer spirit blowing past all her battered exhaustion is...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What's with that look, as if you've been struck by a magic bullet?
You simply hadn't realized my hidden power until now.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Haven't you forgotten? An Umamusume's strength
is neither about speed nor her race record."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Neither speed nor track record? Then...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! In short, it is about 'caliber'!
The little details are nothing more than jewels on a crown.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If one is a king, they will triumph in the end.
By overpowering everything, without fail!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's meet at the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...
Ayabe...-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I thought the Classic Triple Crown would be a showdown with you.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"It's not that simple.
If you can't even manage your own physical condition..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected rival can trip you up at any moment.
To think that Opera O would...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
The next Japanese Derby is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road nods.
The Opera O who played the clown
has finally cast off her veil.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby was undoubtedly
shaping up to be a three-way battle.
